pages.title: Vent Grazer
pages.text: $(thing)Vent Grazer$(): A pale shrimp that circles the hydrothermal chimneys, grazing the bacteria on them. Well fed, it splits off another; it flees any eel. The prey of Titan's hidden ocean. Found in Titan's hidden ocean, round its vents.$(br2)$(thing)Drops$(): Vent Biofilm.
